text:
julia: FYI there's a docs PR ready that needs reviewer coverage before we can merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 -- it's got SDK snippet updates + a short migration note. Need 2 reviewers and a link-check pass.
omar: pinging reviewers now. Which parts are highest risk?
julia: SDK snippets (python/js) are the main risk, plus the migration note touches the config API example. links need a quick sweep.
lee: I'm on the docs rotation but OOO Wed-Thu next week. Can take SDK snippets review if it's before Wed EOD. :raised_hands:
mike: I can take the JS snippets today. Quick look only. :eyes:
julia: awesome. mike for JS, lee for python snippets. ana can you do the link checks?
ana: oops, wrong account. ana: Yep I can run the link-checker and fix broken anchors.
build-bot: deploy-preview failed: netlify build error during docs preview step. Error: "Timeout downloading theme". Logs: ```Build log excerpt... Download failed after 3 attempts```
eng-oncall-bot: Known intermittent in netlify region this morning. Workaround: trigger a rebuild or fallback to static link check locally with `yarn docs:linkcheck` until preview is green.
omar: If preview is flaky, can we still merge after approvals and then trigger a rebuild? worried about leaving site in broken state.
julia: prefer to wait for preview success OR confirm local link-check + one more approver. Let's aim to merge around 12:30pm PT to avoid late-day rollups.
mike: I've skimmed the JS snippets, left 2 tiny nit comments on the PR. will re-review after fixes. :thumbsup:
lee: python snippet looks good but I left a clarification comment on the migration example (small rename suggestion). once addressed i'm happy to approve.
nana: finished link-check locally, fixed two anchors and pushed a tiny commit to the PR. no broken external links found.
julia: thanks all. I'll add reviewers to the PR (mike, lee) and tag `docs-merge-window: midday`. If both approve and CI preview passes (or eng-oncall confirms safe), I'll merge and trigger a rebuild.
omar: noted. tagging @eng-oncall if preview flakes again. :bell:
julia: final plan: reviewers mike + lee, link-check by ana, target merge 12:30pm PT, merge only after 2 approvals + preview green OR eng-oncall thumbs-up. I'll post a quick status update here when merging. :shipit:
mike: +1
lee: +1
eng-oncall-bot: Acknowledge. Will watch the preview and post status.
build-bot: Rebuild queued.
julia: merging now (if approvals still valid).
